Bid Eligibility Criteria: NTPC’s Source Standardisation Circular S-011(2024), dated- 04.04.2024” is applicable for this Tender. Only vendors enlisted under the aforesaid Source Standardisation for the supply of Liquor Ammonia sh all be eligible to participate in this tender. Other bidders shall not be considered. Bids by vendors not meeting this criterion shall be outrightly rejected. Authorized Dealers of NTPC’s source-standardized vendors can also participate in this tender. However, such dealers shall have to submit their Bid-Specific Authorization Certificate, issued by sourc e-standardized vendors, for evaluation of their bids. The clauses of “Conflict of interest” given below w ill be applicable for both the principals and their authorized dealers. · GeM Contract shall be issued in t he name of the vendor who submits offer in GeM. 3. Additional Term condition Test Report: Test Certificate as per IS 799 from 'Manufacturers / NABL accredited laboratory / ISO 17025 certified Lab t o be submitted by vendor along with material along with each consignment. If chemical delivery is throug h a dealer, the test certificate of the supplied chemicals should only be from the Manufacturer's/Govt/ NAB L accredited/ISO 17025 certified Lab; not of the dealer's own lab. Acceptance of material shall be based on testing at PVUNL for strength (Ammonia %), Chloride and Silica. Delivery Schedule: Staggered Delivery as per PVUNL requirement throughout the contract period. Vendor shall be intimated 15 days in advance to affect the supplies. Price Basis: FOR basis and Supplier will be responsible for transportation and safe delivery of material at P VUNL. PO Quantity variation : ±20 % The supplier will not have any claim whatsoever in this regard. Tender is specific for NTPC Source Standardized- S-011 (2024) Manufacturers only. Bids from their author ized dealer are acceptable for further evaluation. However, the authorization letter from the Source Standa rdized Manufacturers should be tender specific and they have to stand guarantee for the quality of supplie d material ordered on their authorized dealer. In case of Award, authorized dealer has to supply material f rom Source Standardized manufacturer only, along with supporting documents. Contract period : one year from the date of award of PO. Warranty: Not Applicable; **If any lot will be rejected at PVUNL, vendor has to replace at their own risk, cost &arrangement. All safety norms and statutory requirements (including amendments thereof), as applicable shall be compl ied with including: Availability of TREM card for the material to be transported. Availability of personal protective equipment. Availability of MSDS with each consignment. All driver/concerned staffs should be well aware about material safety data sheet (MSDS) of the hazardous chemical they are carrying, and it must be implemented whenever applicable.
